title: Pottery Classes with Gas Reduction Firing
source_quote: Finally we are the only teaching studio in SLC offering cone 10 gas reduction firings (other that the U and Westminster) in our big 35 cubic foot natural gas kiln.
evidence_sentence: Pottery class enrollment includes access to cone 10 gas reduction firings in a 35 cubic foot natural gas kiln.
evidence_quote: Finally we are the only teaching studio in SLC offering cone 10 gas reduction firings (other that the U and Westminster) in our big 35 cubic foot natural gas kiln.
summary: Petersen Art Center pottery classes include access to cone 10 gas reduction firings in a 35 cubic foot natural gas kiln. Classes meet four times monthly plus studio time.
how_to_join: Enroll in pottery classes through the center.
